programmes.nameEn: Bachelor of Fine Arts in Music Performance
programmes.descriptionEn: Information on undergraduate music performance programs at the Carnegie Mellon University School of Music.

detailSections.bodyEn: Information on undergraduate music performance programs at the Carnegie Mellon University School of Music.

Carnegie Mellon courses are measured in units rather than credits or credit hours, with three units equaling a standard credit. There is no charge for extra credits taken at Carnegie Mellon. For more specific information regarding curriculum for the undergraduate Instrumental Performance program, click here . Audition/Portfolio Review Requirements
